note: The fuzz input bytes are wrapped as a UA_ByteString and passed into the JSON decoder.
A decoded Variant body is allocated based on the attacker-controlled JSON type and body shape.
Nested JSON fields are decoded into the allocated object, including LocalizedText members.
The clear routine assumes the LocalizedText members still own valid storage and must only run once per live object.
The Variant destructor walks the decoded body and frees nested members again, triggering the use-after-free when the same LocalizedText storage is cleared twice.
